name: Vampie Tale
source:
Poor you! You were caught prisoner by deadly vampire. Can you escape? Or will you end up as the vampire's dinner?  How will you escape? This is the story of Dustin and Margaret.

[from [url=https://ozaki-studio.itch.io/vampie-tale]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
可怜的你！你被致命的吸血鬼俘虏了。你能逃脱吗？或者你最终会成为吸血鬼的晚餐吗？你将如何逃脱？这是达斯汀和玛格丽特的故事。

[来自[url=https://ozaki-studio.itch.io/vampie-tale]itch.io[/url]]
